how_to.create_task: Add control/tasks/<task_id>.json (schema: control/schemas/task.schema.json) with status PENDING on branch mythos/control.
how_to.read_report: control/reports/<task_id>.json (and .md) appears when the task reaches COMPLETED, BLOCKED, FAILED or CANCELLED.
how_to.cancel_task: Set status to CANCELLED in the task file while it is PENDING, CLAIMED or IN_PROGRESS.
